🎥🎬: The Big Bang Theory

Leonard Hofstadter and Sheldon Cooper are brilliant physicists who spend most of their time working at Caltech, playing video games, discussing science, and sharing their apartment. Their carefully structured lives change when Penny, an aspiring actress who lives across the hall, enters their world.

Penny quickly becomes part of their unusual social circle, which includes Howard Wolowitz and Raj Koothrappali. Their friendships lead to countless awkward dates, scientific arguments, roommate disasters, and hilarious clashes between their intellectual world and everyday life.

As the years go by, the group grows closer and evolves through relationships, careers, marriage, and major life changes. Despite their differences, they become a tight-knit group whose friendship remains at the center of their lives.
